name: DashCore
description: DashCore 0.8.6-alpha: Android64 diagnostic build for Geometry Dash. Defers the GLES compute probe until after the 600-frame gameplay timing window so GPU validation does not contaminate DrawScene measurements. No rendering optimization is enabled; live culling remains hard-disabled.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling (locked off)
experimental-render-culling.description: Diagnostic alpha only. Live object hiding is hard-disabled until trigger classification and camera-space bounds are validated.
